verdict.rationale: Puzzle's own help center documents exporting a full general ledger and financial statements, on cash or accrual basis, in Excel, CSV and PDF, so the core ledger can leave in open formats. Nothing shows export of everything else, such as invoices, bills, customer and vendor records, attachments, rules or settings, or a one-shot full-account archive for offboarding. The MCP and API give programmatic read access, but they are not documented as an export or exit path. Missing for 10: documented export of non-ledger records (invoices, contacts, documents, rules), a complete account archive or offboarding workflow, and independent or hands-on confirmation of export completeness.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave

citations.quote: Yes, you can export a full general ledger and financial statements on either cash or accrual basis in excel, csv, and pdf formats.
